description: rc.4: opening capture (the hotkey, or the tray's Open) while the permission report says Automation is not granted switches the same panel window to onboarding before capturing (nothing captured, nothing opened); with Automation granted the capture runs and stays on route capture; once a check has said granted, a later not-granted report does not bring onboarding back in that session
requirement: P2-capture-permission-gate (rc.4 parity, Tauri dist/panel.js refreshPermissions/showOnboarding: onboarding until Automation is granted)
notes: Tauri reference (c82d048^): dist/panel.js refreshPermissions() at boot showed onboarding until canUseCapture(report) (Automation 'granted'); desktop/src/main.rs showed the panel at launch. The GPUI app routes at capture open instead, so nothing pops up at launch.

The capture fixture SUCCEEDS (capture-ok.json): capture-permission-route.json covers the failed-capture route, which already exists on main. Here only the permission report can move the panel to onboarding, so on main (no pre-capture check) the route stays capture and the round-1 route step fails.
The report is the `permission` fixture onboarding reads (views/onboarding.rs check_permissions); automation builds never run the osascript probe.
Round 1: hotkey with permissions-two-missing.json: route onboarding in the same window and process, no link stored (graph resource_count 0: the capture was skipped), nothing opened.
Round 2: restart (replays two-missing) and open capture through the tray path (`open_view`, shell Command::Open): also onboarding.
Round 3: restart, load permissions-all-granted.json: the hotkey captures (Example Domain shown, phase captured) and the route is still capture a second later.

Round 4, same instance: hide, load permissions-two-missing.json, capture again: Automation was confirmed granted this session, so onboarding does not reappear (the stale report is not re-read); the capture runs.
